scenarios.text: Plan my Saturday morning for me. Dad needs his prescriptions dropped off by ten, I owe a client two hours of manuscript edits before my one o'clock call, and I'd like my usual morning spot worked in somewhere. Map out a sensible route and schedule starting from my apartment, including when to leave and roughly how long each stop takes, and remind me of anything I'm likely to forget.

Plan my weekend for me. Dad needs his prescriptions picked up, and I still owe my landlord the account details for the new rent auto-pay. Fit in groceries, laundry, and a long run along the Eastern Trail. I've been running on fumes, so build in one full day of proper downtime — I need to actually recharge.

Plan my Saturday morning hour by hour. I'd like to fit in my usual workout before I take Dad to his 11 a.m. cardiology appointment, but I'm dropping my only copy of the apartment key at the locksmith Friday afternoon, so cover how I'll get back inside afterward. Include timings, what to bring for Dad, and anything I should sort out the night before.

My dad is staying at my place this week while his apartment gets repainted, and his nurse is coming by Sunday to set up his new tablet. Draft a note for her with simple step-by-step instructions to get it connected to the internet, since she's easily flustered by tech and I won't be home to help. Also recommend the best arrival window so everything's wrapped up before my usual Sunday evening plans.

I have the Kestrel manuscript to line-edit, Dad has a string of specialist appointments I'll be driving him to, and I want to be sure billing doesn't fall through the cracks. Build me a realistic weekly rhythm with specific time blocks for deep editing, plus a note about exactly when my invoices should go out.
